messages:
Maya R: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — vendor auth outage (AuthX), model-registry token churn, and GCP rate-limits. listing owners+due dates below. Please ack.

Liam C: ack. can we get a runbook draft by EOD?

Maya R: yes — Diego owns runbook for AuthX fallback. ETA Tue 2026-03-31. Owner: Diego S. Tasks: add short-circuit fallback, cache TTL + circuit breaker.

Diego S: got it, will sketch in docs repo and ping for review. putting task in the incident board.

Olivia K: i'll pair on the circuit-breaker logic — queue a 30m with diego.

Emma T: model-registry token rotation — I'll own rotation automation. goal: reduce manual steps and add expiry alert. ETA Fri 2026-04-04.

Liam C: for GCP rate-limits — ops_lead to validate quotas and request increases, plus add regional fallback policy. who's ops_lead?

Ops Lead: i'll take quota request, Diego will add fallback routing to multi-region. ETA 48h for quota ticket.

sre-bot: Reminder: runbook template created at https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/template.md

Maya R: noted: consolidated action items —
- Diego S: AuthX fallback runbook + PR (due 2026-03-31)
- Olivia K: Circuit-breaker impl review + test (due 2026-04-02)
- Emma T: Registry token rotation automation + alerting (due 2026-04-04)
- Ops Lead: GCP quota ticket + regional fallback config (due 2026-03-29)
- Liam C: schedule canary dry-run and post-dryrun report (due 2026-04-06)

Liam C: scheduling canary for 2026-04-05 10:00 PT, adding to calendar.

Diego S: created branch: feat/authx-fallback, short snippet:
```
if authx.unavailable():
  use_local_jwks_cache()
  fallback_to_cached_tokens()
```

Olivia K: thanks, i'll add unit tests and a sim in chaos env.

Emma T: will add alert rule: model-registry:token-rotation-failures > 3 in 15m -> pager oncall

Maya R: good. also proposal: rotate ownership every 6 weeks across infra team to avoid ownership burnout. thoughts?

Liam C: +1

Diego S: fine by me, need a small doc on handover steps.

Ops Lead: agree. will add 'handoff checklist' to runbook template.

Maya R: plan to review status in ops sync next Tue. If anyone blocks earlier, ping me directly. :pray:

sre-bot: Task created: INCIDENT-4827 in tracker — assigned to Diego S (due 2026-03-31)

Olivia K: acked

Diego S: ack

Emma T: ack
